reason: I already have my own bike, it just has a flat tyre. Fixing it costs me a few euros once, and then I don't pay anything every month, so I'd rather do that than sign up for another app.
objection: With only 10 bikes in the whole town, I doubt one will actually be standing at the station when my train gets in, and I can't risk being late because the app shows nothing nearby.
would_change_my_mind: A few bikes guaranteed to be parked right at Schleswig station every morning, so I could count on one for the last stretch.
